name: osm-navigator
description: Personal turn-by-turn navigation PWA — this file exists only to support the optional Capacitor native Android shell. The web app itself has no build step; open index.html directly or serve the folder statically.

scripts.cap:copy: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html app.js config.js idb.js native-location.js native-tts.js native-back.js style.css manifest.json sw.js www/ && cp -r icons www/icons && cp -r vendor www/vendor
scripts.cap:sync: npm run cap:copy && cap sync android
